_comment: STAGE 0 SMOKE at 300 steps: 6 of the gate pairs, seed 73 only, plus the same-GPU null. Purpose: prove the virtual clock and the data path (protocol gate 0: 2,097,152 tokens / 8,387,440 bytes scored), read the noise floor, and see the SIGN of the large effects. NOT acceptance: late-paying mechanisms (attention-source reuse may be one) and the 300-step phase geometry are not the full run. --steps 300 makes train_gpu.py rescale the virtual clock so the 6%/20% phase switches and the cooldown keep their fractions.

as0.what: attention-source reuse OFF (empty FF_ATTN_SRC disables; the pair's control knob)

k60.what: K60 base exactly (train.py bakes LK 0.35 fnm, FF_ATTN_SRC=5:6,7,8, KO 0.3, ACC_IN_GRAPH 1, ramp3, QK 1.44, MOM_PEAK 0.95, WD_SCHED 0, softcap 15 / A 0, warmup 20, EMB_LR 0.30)

noramp.what: no k1 phase (the ramp3 pair's control)

relu2.what: K57-style relu^2 activation (the pair's control knobs)

repeat.what: k60 seed 73 re-run on the SAME GPU: kernel nondeterminism null

rf.what: relu^2 with the custom backward (RF); FF_LEAKY_RELU2=0 added because K60 bakes 0.35 and the Trainium rf arm ran on the LEAKY=0 base
